title: The wire: artifacts types
description: Part of the source of every type on the wire (#1135, #5380): one file per domain in Packages/Wire/schema. A $ref to another file names it (core.schema.json#/definitions/JSONValue); scripts/wire.sh gen reads them all.

Artifact.description: An artifact's record (#5953, spec 5713 §1): its name, kind, labels and head. Its versions are OCI image manifests in the blob store.

id.description: The artifact's id, unique in the organisation's store: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

topic.description: Its project's id, or the organisation's; the <topic> of its ref.

ref.description: agents:artifact:<topic>#<id>: the name form, which moves with the head.

labels.description: Free labels, key to value: at most 32, a key at most 64 bytes and a value at most 256. A version carries them as dev.agentloops.label.<key> annotations.

head.description: The current version's manifest digest; the newest head when there are two or more.

heads.description: Every head, when writers diverged (a write whose parent was not the head): set aside, never overwritten. Absent with one head.

versions.description: How many versions it has; the newest is this number.

deleted.description: The head is a tombstone: the artifact was deleted, and its versions are kept.

ArtifactGet.description: artifacts/get: an artifact by its ref, the head for a name (agents:artifact:<topic>#<id>) or one version for a digest (agents:artifact:<topic>#sha256:…).

content.description: Also send each layer's bytes, at most 24 MiB in all; a larger version is refused.

ArtifactGot.description: artifacts/get's answer: the record and the version the ref names.

ArtifactKind.description: What an artifact is (epic #5713): its version's artifactType is application/vnd.agentloops.<kind>.v1.

ArtifactLayer.description: One file of a version: an OCI descriptor.

mediaType.description: The file's own type, as text/markdown or image/svg+xml.

data.description: The bytes, when artifacts/get was asked for content.

ArtifactLayerPut.description: One file of a version to put.

title.description: The file's name: no '/', at most 255 bytes.

ArtifactPut.description: artifacts/put: a new version of an artifact, or its first, which makes the record. At most 64 layers and 24 MiB in all.

name.description: Sets the name; the first version's default is the id.

kind.description: Required for the first version; a later one keeps the record's.

labels.description: Free labels, key to value: at most 32, a key at most 64 bytes and a value at most 256. A version carries them as dev.agentloops.label.<key> annotations.

parents.description: The head (or heads) the writer saw: none for the first version, two or more to settle a divergence. A parent that is no longer a head makes a second head, never an overwrite.

capture.description: How the version was made (dev.agentloops.capture); manual when absent.

tombstone.description: Delete: a version with no layers that marks the artifact deleted; its versions are kept.

diverged.description: The parents were not every head, so the artifact now has two or more heads.

ArtifactVersion.description: One version: its manifest, as the record and the log say it.

number.description: Its place in the artifact's log, from 1.

digest.description: The manifest's digest: the version's id, immutable.

author.description: Who made it, recorded, never guessed: person:<id>, session:<id> or unknown.

layers.description: Its files; absent in a listing.

next.description: Pass as before for the next page; absent on the last.

ArtifactVersionsAsk.description: artifacts/versions: an artifact's versions, newest first.

BlobInfo.description: A blob in the artifact store (#5715, epic #5713): bytes at a sha256 digest.

digest.description: The blob's id, "sha256:" and 64 lower-case hex digits.

stored.description: When the blob was first written, in RFC 3339.

BlobPage.description: One page of a blob listing, in digest order, at most 1000 blobs (#5715).

next.description: Pass as the next listing's after to get the next page; absent on the last page.
